_comment: Machine-readable expectations for scripts/regress.py. Times in seconds; tol = +-seconds (default 1.5). 'category' is checked when given. 'forbid' ranges must not overlap any segment; must_not_skip = zero skip segments. Keep in sync with testset.md. 'start_late_ok' allows a later-than-expected start by that many seconds. An entry may carry 'meta' (title, creator, channelId, kind, description, paidPromotion, duration) sent with the request, an 'id' when the same video appears twice, and 'expect_meta' (hints, brand, creator, duration, disclosure) checked against the job and the stats row.
